newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 254-7 AT THE CLOSE AGAINST BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 254-7 AT THE CLOSE AGAINST BOLAND.

text.p: A century for captain Pieter Strydom rescued Border on the first day of their Supersport series match against Boland at Buffalo Park on Friday.
At the close Border were 254 for seven.

Strydom's 100, including 13 fours, kept Border in the match after they lost their first four wickets for just 35 runs -- three of them to Boland seamer Chrisjan Vorster who finished with three for 61.
Strydom and Peter Kirsten put on 73 for the fifth wicket before the captain and Steven Pope (77 not out) shared a century partnership for the sixth wicket.
B.du Plessis c Oosthuizen b Vorster 0
To bat: Peter Emslie, Makhaya Ntini
Bowling: H.Williams 23-6-62-3, Willoughby 18-10-27-0, Vorster 19-6-61-3, Henderson 32-10-90-1, Truter 2-0-5-0
Boland - Andrew Wessels, Lloyd Ferreira, Wayne Trutter, Kenny Jackson (captain), Elton Williams, Andrew Wylie, Riaan Oosthuizen, Chrisjan Vorster, Claude Henderson, Henry Williams, Charl Willoughby
